daily.topThemeTitle: AI Governance Moves From Experimentation to Policy
daily.topThemeBody: EdSurge revisits the Department of Education's August 20 guidance distinguishing recreational from instructional technology, while ISTE+ASCD's new AI-literacy partnership with Google and Brookings' Global Task Force keep pushing districts from pilot projects toward real oversight.
